name: Send for review
purpose: Sends a change to the people who decide, before it reaches the library.
rules: There is no Undo: once it goes, the place it was sent from says so, Sent for review or Suggestion sent, with what happens next.
To take it back, the author picks Back to draft in More actions on the review: reviewers are not asked until it is sent again. A suggestion stays with the DS lead, who decides.
One verb, set by the team: Send suggestion when the DS lead reviews suggestions, Send for review when changes go straight to review.
